# FontViewer

**Class:** `UltraCanvasFontViewer` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasFontViewer.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasFontViewer.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasFontViewer.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Every glyph in a font file, scrolling, without installing it

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasFontViewer> CreateFontViewer( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasFontViewer(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onGlyphSelected` | `std::function<void(size_t entry)> onGlyphSelected` | Fired when the selection changes, with NoEntry when it is cleared. |
| `onGlyphActivated` | `std::function<void(size_t entry)> onGlyphActivated` | Fired when a cell is double-clicked - a host's cue to do something with the character (insert it, copy it). |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Options and setters

Everything that configures the element: appearance, behaviour and content.

| Member | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `SetFaceIndex` | `bool SetFaceIndex(int index)` |  |
| `SetCellSize` | `void SetCellSize(int pixels)` | Edge of one glyph cell in logical pixels; clamped to a legible range. Changing it rebuilds the layout and drops the glyph cache. |
| `ShowRange` | `void ShowRange(size_t rangeIndex)` | Scroll so that a range - an index into GetFace().Ranges() - or a particular character is at the top of the view. Both are no-ops when the font does not have them. |
| `SetSelectedEntry` | `void SetSelectedEntry(size_t entry)` |  |
| `SetControlsVisible` | `void SetControlsVisible(bool visible)` | The control bar above the grid and the information line below it. A host with its own chrome turns them off and drives the viewer through the API instead. |
| `SetStyle` | `void SetStyle(const FontViewerStyle& s)` |  |
| `SetBounds` | `void SetBounds(const Rect2Df& b) override` | Resizing re-flows the grid: the column count comes from the width, so the scroll range and every cell position move with it. Both entries matter - a viewer positioned by hand arrives through SetBounds, one inside a flex or grid parent through Arrange, and the layout engine never calls the former. |

The rectangle covers the glyph and its caption, and is off-screen for an entry that is scrolled out of view. |
